The problem · what the field told us

The CRM didn't
fit the field.

Gift officers spend their days out — donor homes, parish offices, events. Atlas on the desktop is eighteen modules deep. Powerful at the desk; far too much to carry into a doorway between two meetings.

So the real work slipped to the margins: prepping in the car, remembering details after the visit, logging it hours later — if at all.

Decisions & tradeoffs

Why these calls.

Focus

Five tabs, not eighteen

Problem: the full nav overwhelmed a phone.
Decision: five field tabs; everything else under “More”.
Tradeoff: a couple of taps deeper for desk tasks — worth it for a focused field tool.
Speed

Email & password login — no SSO

Problem: SSO redirects fail on patchy field networks.
Decision: simple, reliable sign-in that just works outside.
Tradeoff: less “enterprise”, far fewer locked-out officers at the door.
Prep

A brief-first home

Problem: dashboards answer “how are we doing”, not “who’s next”.
Decision: lead with today’s meetings and ready briefs.
Tradeoff: metrics move down — the field cares about the next door.
Input

Voice & photo for Guru

Problem: typing long queries one-handed is painful.
Decision: ask by voice, or snap a card / pledge form.
Tradeoff: more input modes to design — matches hands-busy reality.

03 · Guru in the field

The desktop’s natural-language donor intelligence, rebuilt for hands-busy moments — speak the question, or photograph a pledge form, and get a list you can act on.

Focus · the rest, one tap away

Five tabs.
Not eighteen.

The field never sees the full platform — but nothing is missing. Everything else lives, organised and searchable, under “More”.

Focus where it counts; depth when it’s needed.

focus where it counts.

One system.
Two surfaces.

The companion isn’t a separate app — it’s the same Constellation design system as the desktop, re-tuned for touch. One language, so mobile and desktop stay in step as both grow.

Design
Make it fit the thumb.
Engineering
Make it fast on field networks.
1 language
shared across mobile & desktop.

Tokens, reused

Color, type and spacing inherited straight from the desktop system.

Touch components

Tap targets, sheets and nav re-tuned for one-handed use.

Every state

Empty, loading, offline and error designed for patchy field networks.
